features.name: Trial and tighten the harness from real sessions
features.description: Observe the next few real tasks, prune noisy topics, and add missing query paths only where agents still drift or over-read.
features.evidence: Used real repo-maintenance tasks on 2026-07-09 through 2026-07-11 to tighten the harness five ways: first by switching Node workspace defaults from pnpm to npm, then by adding explicit Before state, After state, Regression test results, PR ready, and CI ready checkpoints to `AGENTS.md`, `.repo-harness/topics/agent-workflow.md`, `progress.md`, and `session-handoff.md`, then by recreating the isolated-modules migration handoff as an in-repo artifact at `isolated-modules-migration-handoff.md`, then by executing that migration: removing the root Node workspace file, moving active Node modules to module-local `package-lock.json` plus `npm ci --include=dev`, eliminating shared `workspace` and shared TS-config assumptions, and verifying representative modules through `./scripts/module ci`, and finally by using a live `xq-kraken` review/fix task to confirm the harness supports narrow module work while documenting a contract correction in `modules/xq-kraken/model/api_catalog.py` and `modules/xq-kraken/API_CATALOG_CONTRACT.md`.
